game.name: Crossy Road
game.rules:
1. **Video Proof** - The preferable format of this is YouTube, but it doesn't need to be. Make sure other platforms are allowed to view your video, i.e. your video shouldn't be restricted to only being able to be viewed on YouTube. We won't accept videos that expire. You don't need to time yourself, the mods will fix it. Just estimate if you can't time. I recommend WatchFrameByFrame.com, as it's easy to find exact frames and works for YouTube and Vimeo videos.

2. **Make Sure the Start Frame (White Hand/Menu/Play Button) is Shown** - We get lots of videos that don't show the hand that disappears when you tap the screen. This makes it impossible to accurately time you. Also please don't end the video on the exact frame that you achieve a certain distance, as it can mess with timing software.

3. **Pausing** - Pausing is not allowed in runs. If it is "unintentional", we may not reject your video, but you must unpause instantly. It is up to mod discretion. If it is a notable run, multiple mods will have to decide. They will take into account variable such as nature of what caused the pause, whether there was an advantage to be gained, and how far into the run it is.

4. **Cheating** - Cheating can either result in a warning, suspension, or ban, depending on the nature and severity of it. It is up to our discretion. The mods have more tools on their side than you might realize. Play fair.

5. **Platforms** - Make sure you click the appropriate platform both times. When looking at runs, we often see someone select "Mobile," and forget to change the next part, so it says "Mobile/PC" which of course doesn't make sense. If you see a run miscategorized, please tell a mod. Special phone operating systems such as Windows or Fire TV will fall under Android.

6. **Extra Controls** - If you play PC, you can't remap your buttons, or else it goes in the Autoclickers/Scroll Wheel tab. Make sure your runs go in the appropriate places. Mobile players can use controllers. Keyboards, however, are not allowed. If one was used, it would go into Unrestricted.

7. **Contact** - Don't be afraid to message a mod. You can use this site or a mod's Discord (preferred), which should be view-able from their profile. If you would like your or someone else's run retimed because you have checked and found it to be incorrect, please message a mod. If you take issue with a mod, please message a mod of superior rank.
-Both on these forums and our discord page, be respectful. Unreasonable behavior can result in either a warning or a ban. For further questions/concerns, contact myself for Speedrun issues, and NoahKaiser for Discord issues.
-Redundant forum posts may be deleted. Don't take it personally.

8. **Rule Changes** - Rules are always subject to change. Sometimes more proof is required to uphold accuracy. At one point, only photos were required to verify high scores, and now we require video. "Grandfathered" runs may or may not be removed, depending on the change. As certain runs become faster and faster, we may ask you to submit extra evidence to back up an exceedingly fast run.
-PC times under 1.25 (25 hops) and 3 seconds (50 hops) require a hand camera and game audio. For mobile, times under 4.133 (25 hops) and 10 seconds (50 hops) require game audio. For Web, times under 3.75 (25 hops) and 11 seconds (50 hops) require game audio.
9. **Game Modes** - Only the original mode is allowed unless otherwise stated. Any mode that has "different qualities" isn't allowed, I.E. no polar bear runs, no Pac-man runs, no cannon runs, no At-Home runs, no Japan runs, no PSY runs, and no Cheerleader runs, as these all have gameplay differences that make them different besides their looks. They belong in either their own categories or unrestricted areas.

- Pecking Order runs are not allowed in any category.

10. **Score Maxouts**- When someone reaches 9,999, the game no longer keeps track of the score. When this happens, please keep going, as we may implement a way to track scores after this. If you achieve this score or above, mods will put "99x" in the hours place, and then follow it with the time it took to achieve said score. "x" is whatever place they would be on the leaderboard then. Fastest to get said score would have a "9" there.

newsList.body: Hi All! We have decided to implement a new rule that affects 25 hops mobile runs. From this point on, all mobile runs that are under 4.133 seconds require game audio. categories.name: 25 Hops
categories.rules:
Time starts on the frame when either the hand under "Crossy Road" disappears, the menu starts moving away, or the play button is pressed, depending on the version. Time ends the frame 25 appears on screen. Video evidence is required, and must show the hand (also the menu or play button works) before the run starts as well as the frame that the 25 is reached. Any tools used other than using you hand for tapping or clicking is banned (I.E. no autoclickers).

Pecking Order is not allowed.

For mobile, times under 4.133 require game audio.

For PC runs, any time that is below 1.250 must show a hand and keyboard cam for the duration of the run to be potentially verified.

For Web, times under 3.750 require game audio.

values.name: Death%
values.rules: Die as fast as you can. Time starts when the hand disappears and ends when you lose control of your character (when your character tilts sideways against a car, first touches water, etc.).

values.name: 10 Coins
values.rules: Time starts on the first frame in which your coin count goes up after the collection of your first coin and ends upon the first frame of your final count after collecting the final coin. Coins can be collected across multiple runs. Red coins are not counted.

values.name: 100 Coins (With Red)
values.rules: Time starts on the frame of you acquiring your first coin in your set of 100. It doesn't have to be your first coin of that run, and can be across multiple continuous runs. If your video shows more than 100 coins being collected, expect the first 100 to be what is timed. Only coins acquired in a run count.

values.name: 100 Coins (No Red)
values.rules: Time starts on the frame of you acquiring your first coin in your set of 100. It doesn't have to be your first coin of that run, and can be across multiple continuous runs. If your video shows more than 100 coins being collected, expect the first 100 to be what is timed. Only coins acquired in a run count. You may not collect red coins in this category.

values.name: 10 Lilypads
values.rules:
Land on 10 different Lilypads. Timing starts on the frame before the first hop and ends when landing on the 10th Lilypad. Astroids are not allowed.
Please note that timing still starts upon the disappearing of the hand like in other runs, not upon touching your first lilypad.

High Score but using a "banned" theme. values.name: Most Coins (Red)
values.rules: Collect the most coins in a single run. Original gamemode only. Red coins are allowed.

values.name: Most Coins (No Red)
values.rules: Collect the most coins in a single run. Original gamemode only. Red coins are not counted towards your total.

values.name: No Side Hops
values.rules: Any character. Only forwards and backwards movement allowed, no side to side. Score ends upon death or your first side hop.

values.name: Both llamas
values.rules: Played with the "Llama" character. Get the highest score with both llamas. Scoring ends when either llama dies. The high score of the leading llama is what counts. If the llama goes off screen and isn't seen again, it is assumed dead.

categories.name: 100 Hops
categories.rules:
Time starts on the frame when either the hand under "Crossy Road" disappears, the menu starts moving away, or the play button is pressed, depending on the version. Time ends the frame 100 appears on screen. Video evidence is required, and must show the hand (also the menu or play button works) before the run starts as well as the frame that the 100 is reached. Any tools used other than using you hand for tapping or clicking is banned (I.E. no autoclickers).

Pecking Order is not allowed.

categories.name: Pac-Man Times
categories.rules: These are the categories in the main leaderboard except using Pac-Man, which collects points by collecting white dots rather than advancing forward. Video evidence is required, and must show the hand (also the menu or play button works) before the run starts as well as the frame that the point value needed is reached.

categories.name: Misc. Scores
categories.rules: Scored categories too arbitrary to become main page scores. They didn't want to give us a separate page for these.

games.name: Crossy Road
games.rules:
1. **Video Proof** - The preferable format of this is YouTube, but it doesn't need to be. Make sure other platforms are allowed to view your video, i.e. your video shouldn't be restricted to only being able to be viewed on YouTube. We won't accept videos that expire. You don't need to time yourself, the mods will fix it. Just estimate if you can't time. I recommend WatchFrameByFrame.com, as it's easy to find exact frames and works for YouTube and Vimeo videos.

2. **Make Sure the Start Frame (White Hand/Menu/Play Button) is Shown** - We get lots of videos that don't show the hand that disappears when you tap the screen. This makes it impossible to accurately time you. Also please don't end the video on the exact frame that you achieve a certain distance, as it can mess with timing software.

3. **Pausing** - Pausing is not allowed in runs. If it is "unintentional", we may not reject your video, but you must unpause instantly. It is up to mod discretion. If it is a notable run, multiple mods will have to decide. They will take into account variable such as nature of what caused the pause, whether there was an advantage to be gained, and how far into the run it is.

4. **Cheating** - Cheating can either result in a warning, suspension, or ban, depending on the nature and severity of it. It is up to our discretion. The mods have more tools on their side than you might realize. Play fair.

5. **Platforms** - Make sure you click the appropriate platform both times. When looking at runs, we often see someone select "Mobile," and forget to change the next part, so it says "Mobile/PC" which of course doesn't make sense. If you see a run miscategorized, please tell a mod. Special phone operating systems such as Windows or Fire TV will fall under Android.

6. **Extra Controls** - If you play PC, you can't remap your buttons, or else it goes in the Autoclickers/Scroll Wheel tab. Make sure your runs go in the appropriate places. Mobile players can use controllers. Keyboards, however, are not allowed. If one was used, it would go into Unrestricted.

7. **Contact** - Don't be afraid to message a mod. You can use this site or a mod's Discord (preferred), which should be view-able from their profile. If you would like your or someone else's run retimed because you have checked and found it to be incorrect, please message a mod. If you take issue with a mod, please message a mod of superior rank.
-Both on these forums and our discord page, be respectful. Unreasonable behavior can result in either a warning or a ban. For further questions/concerns, contact myself for Speedrun issues, and NoahKaiser for Discord issues.
-Redundant forum posts may be deleted. Don't take it personally.

8. **Rule Changes** - Rules are always subject to change. Sometimes more proof is required to uphold accuracy. At one point, only photos were required to verify high scores, and now we require video. "Grandfathered" runs may or may not be removed, depending on the change. As certain runs become faster and faster, we may ask you to submit extra evidence to back up an exceedingly fast run.
-PC times under 1.25 (25 hops) and 3 seconds (50 hops) require a hand camera and game audio. For mobile, times under 4.133 (25 hops) and 10 seconds (50 hops) require game audio. For Web, times under 3.75 (25 hops) and 11 seconds (50 hops) require game audio.
9. **Game Modes** - Only the original mode is allowed unless otherwise stated. Any mode that has "different qualities" isn't allowed, I.E. no polar bear runs, no Pac-man runs, no cannon runs, no At-Home runs, no Japan runs, no PSY runs, and no Cheerleader runs, as these all have gameplay differences that make them different besides their looks. They belong in either their own categories or unrestricted areas.

- Pecking Order runs are not allowed in any category.

10. **Score Maxouts**- When someone reaches 9,999, the game no longer keeps track of the score. When this happens, please keep going, as we may implement a way to track scores after this. If you achieve this score or above, mods will put "99x" in the hours place, and then follow it with the time it took to achieve said score. "x" is whatever place they would be on the leaderboard then. Fastest to get said score would have a "9" there.
